subject: Mutual Action Plan & POC environment wiring — keys, IP allowlist, VPC peering
messages:
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: alex.perez@pulsehealth.com, samantha.lee@pulsehealth.com
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-12-07T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan & POC environment wiring — keys, IP allowlist, VPC peering

Hi Alex / Samantha —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As discussed, I attached a first-pass mutual action plan (PulseHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx) that splits responsibilities for the POC environment wiring. I captured the critical path items we need to close to start the 2-week evaluation:

- Redwood: create org, generate API keys scoped for POC, provide ephemeral token guidance.
- PulseHealth: provide IP ranges for allowlist, confirm VPC peering owner and acceptance window, share SRE contact for routing testing.

Immediate asks: could you confirm the three public IP CIDR ranges you want on the allowlist and who will own the peering request from PulseHealth? If you prefer, Tom at CloudOps can handle peering and we’ll coordinate on the template (I also attached a peering YAML).

Goal / timeline: masthead is to have environment wired and keys issued by EOD Friday 12/12 so your engineers can begin workload smoke tests the week of 12/15. If that timeline is tight, tell us which item we should prioritize and we’ll shift the rollout.

I’ve cc’d Jordan (eng lead) and Rishi (platform engineer) and Grace (CS) to help with the technical handoff and test plan.

Next steps:
1) Alex/Samantha — confirm allowlist CIDRs + peering owner by 12/08 noon PT
2) Redwood (Jordan/Rishi) — prepare org and scoped POC API keys once we have allowlist details
3) Joint smoke test plan due 12/13; can be 30–60m remote session with SREs

Thanks — look forward to your confirmation.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0134

Attachments: PulseHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx; poc-vpc-peering-template.yaml; allowlist-ips-20251207.csv
From: Alex Perez <alex.perez@pulsehealth.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: samantha.lee@pulsehealth.com, tom.wu@cloudops.consulting
Date: 2025-12-07T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & POC environment wiring — keys, IP allowlist, VPC peering

Neha —

Thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. We can own the peering request from our side — Tom Wu (copied) will run the peering ticket. Our initial allowlist ranges are: 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.0/25, and 192.0.2.128/25. I’ve attached a quick CSV for you (allowlist-ips-20251207.csv).

Couple of notes/questions:
- We prefer Scoped API keys per-team; can Redwood create two keys (eng-testing and cs-observe) with expiration at the end of the 2-week eval?
- Please confirm any required egress rules on our side (e.g., specific ports we must open for health checks).

Tom, can you confirm the peering owner and ETA? We’d like peering accepted by 12/11 EOD if possible.

Alex
VP Product, PulseHealth
alex.perez@pulsehealth.com
From: tom.wu@cloudops.consulting
To: alex.perez@pulsehealth.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, samantha.lee@pulsehealth.com
Date: 2025-12-08T08:25:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & POC environment wiring — keys, IP allowlist, VPC peering

Alex + Neha —

I’ll raise the peering request today. Expected cycle time on our side is 48–72 hours once the configuration is submitted (we need the target account number and the full ASN from Redwood). Neha — can you share Redwood’s VPC ID/account and ASN in the next message? I’ll attach our peering ticket as it fills out.

I’ll also coordinate with PulseHealth SRE for routing validation once the peering is active.

-Tom
Senior Cloud Architect, CloudOps Consulting
From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-12-09T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & POC environment wiring — internal handoff

Team — internal plan based on Alex’s allowlist and Tom’s note:

1) Org & keys: I will create the Redwood org tenant for pulsehealth-poc and generate two scoped API keys (eng-testing, cs-observe). Keys will be time-bound to 14 days. I’ll post the key metadata to the secure share (link below) and request that Alex confirm receipt via Slack DM.
2) VPC info: Redwood ASN: AS65021; Redwood account ID: 987654321012; preferred peering VPC: vpc-0a1b2c3d.
3) Egress/ports: health checks require outbound TCP 443 to PulseHealth endpoints and inbound TCP 443 for TLS flows from your test agents. No other ports needed for the POC baseline.
4) IP allowlist: we will accept their three CIDRs as-is and add to our firewall rules once Tom confirms the peering acceptance event.

I’ll attach the peering YAML (poc-vpc-peering-template.yaml) populated with our values and CC Tom. Target: request submitted today, Redwood side ready for acceptance and key issuance by 12/11 EOD.

Related link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-4123 (poc peering & key task)

-Jordan
Senior Platform Eng, Redwood Inference
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: alex.perez@pulsehealth.com, samantha.lee@pulsehealth.com, tom.wu@cloudops.consulting
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-12-11T16:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & POC environment wiring — confirmation & close timeline

Alex / Samantha / Tom —

Great progress — appreciate the quick turn. Quick status and confirmation against the MAP milestones:

- Peering: Tom submitted the peering ticket this morning; Jordan’s YAML had all fields. Expected acceptance window 12/11–12/12.
- Allowlist: we added their three CIDRs to our temporary POC firewall (will be live after peering acceptance).
- Keys: Jordan created eng-testing and cs-observe scoped keys; they are uploaded to the secure share and have been marked to expire 14 days after issuance. Alex — confirm you can retrieve them and whether you want rotation sooner.
- Smoke test: propose Friday 12/12 10:00 PT for a 30-min joint test (Jordan + PulseHealth SRE). If that works, Grace will send the invite and test checklist.

If all goes green on Friday, we’ll move the evaluation into active ingestion on Monday 12/15. That keeps the agreed 2-week window intact and gives PulseHealth two business weeks of data.

Next practical asks: Alex — confirm invite acceptance for 12/12 10:00 PT and confirm you’ve downloaded the keys. If anything blocks, flag and we’ll triage.

Thanks —
Neha
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

-- End of thread --
